messages.content: Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence. Write 10 prompts to generate portrait images on the occasion of Mother's Day about the Palestinian mother and imagine her as a tree with roots clinging to the ground, as a gift to her on this occasion. Make some prompts into an expressive painting of an old Palestinian mother with wrinkles filling her face and her look full of kindness and tenderness.

message.content:
1. A surreal digital painting of a Palestinian mother whose form transforms into an ancient olive tree, her silver hair becoming branches heavy with fruit, her hands buried deep in the red earth as roots, her face turned toward the sky with a gentle smile, soft golden hour light, Mother's Day tribute, ultra-detailed, 8K 🌿

2. An expressive oil painting of an old Palestinian mother, her face deeply lined with wrinkles that tell stories of resilience, her dark eyes full of kindness and tenderness, a kufiya wrapped around her head, her body dissolving into the gnarled trunk of a fig tree at the base, roots visibly gripping the Palestinian soil, warm autumn palette, thick impasto brushstrokes, emotional and intimate 🎨

3. A watercolor portrait of a Palestinian woman whose lower body merges seamlessly with the exposed roots of a cedar tree, her weathered hands pressed against the ground, her expression serene and motherly, soft pastels, white background, delicate linework, a small bouquet of jasmine flowers at her feet, Mother's Day concept art 🌸

4. A hyper-realistic portrait of an elderly Palestinian mother, every wrinkle on her face mapped like the bark of an old tree, her gaze radiating unconditional tenderness, her fingers intertwined in the earth below, roots spreading wide and deep, symbolic of her unbreakable bond to her land, soft studio lighting, 85mm lens, shallow depth of field 📷

5. A mixed-media collage portrait of a Palestinian mother whose silhouette forms the shape of a massive banyan tree, her silver-streaked hair flowing into a canopy of green leaves, her face composed of bark textures yet still showing warmth and maternal love, roots gripping the soil of a hillside overlooking the sea, layered textures, gold leaf accents, Mother's Day 🕊️

6. An expressive brushstroke painting of an old Palestinian grandmother, her face a landscape of deep wrinkles and crinkles around her eyes that still sparkle with kindness, her weathered hands cradling a small sapling, her body rooted like an ancient oak, paint splatters suggesting tears of joy, raw and emotional, thick palette knife work, large canvas 🖌️

7. A minimalist line art illustration of a Palestinian mother whose body outline is the shape of a tree, her head a round face with soft wrinkles and a tender smile, her torso a trunk, her legs becoming thick roots gripping the ground, simple black ink on cream paper, a single olive branch in her hand, clean and poetic, Mother's Day card design ✍️

8. A cinematic portrait of an elderly Palestinian mother seated on a stone wall, her face a masterwork of age and tenderness, deep-set wrinkles framing eyes that hold oceans of love, behind her a giant olive tree's roots are visible as if the ground is transparent, showing how her life has fed into the earth, dramatic backlighting, shallow bokeh, 35mm film grain 🎬

9. A surrealist portrait of a Palestinian mother whose face is split between human skin and tree bark, her wrinkles doubling as the texture of ancient wood, her hair a full canopy of green, her lower form dissolving into a network of roots that pulse like veins with red and white (the colors of Palestine), roots gripping the soil with determination, Salvador Dali meets Palestinian identity, Mother's Day 🌍

10. A soft gouache portrait of an old Palestinian mother, her face illuminated by candlelight, every line and wrinkle a testament to a lifetime of tenderness and care, her eyes gazing at the viewer with infinite kindness, her hands pressed flat against the ground where roots emerge like fingers of the earth holding her in place, a small heart shape formed between two roots, warm amber tones, intimate and sacred, Mother's Day 🕯️
